title: Finite field for simultaneous descent of closed geometric components
statement: Let k be a field with separable closure Omega [def-kun-separably-closed], and let X -> Spec k be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. If X_Omega has finitely many irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components], there is a finite intermediate field L [def-pc-field-extension] for which the iterated base change Y = X_L times_L Omega [def-pc-fibre-product] has finitely many irreducible components and its projection p:Y -> X_L is surjective. For every irreducible component C of Y there is a closed subset A of X_L with p^{-1}(A)=C. No maximality of A is asserted.

source.place: Tags 04KZ (1),(2), 038B, and 054R proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04KZ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/038B

proof.text: For a component C of X_Omega, let U be the complement of the other finitely many components. Mathlib closure_sUnion_irreducibleComponents_sdiff_singleton gives closure(U)=C. Hence U is nonempty and open. Choose an affine open V contained in U using lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis. It is compact by IsAffineOpen.isCompact. Since V is a nonempty open subset of the irreducible closed set C, subset_closure_inter_of_isPreirreducible_of_isOpen gives closure(V)=C. Apply lem-weil-pbc-galois-base-change-qc-open-descends to V. Its finite intermediate field fixes V under every automorphism fixing that field; the induced map is a homeomorphism, so Homeomorph.image_closure shows it fixes C. This is the proved private helper component_finite_stabilizer; it uses no locally-finite-type assumption.

Induct on the finite set of components. For the empty family use the bottom intermediate field. At an insertion take the compositum of the previous field and the field for the new component. Mathlib IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup supplies finiteness. An automorphism fixing the compositum fixes both subfields, so the induction hypothesis and the new component stabilizer apply. The proved private helper components_finite_stabilizer implements this induction.

Write g=Spec(L/k), gprime=Spec(Omega/L), and gOmega=Spec(Omega/k). The scalar-tower identity gives gprime followed by g=gOmega. The pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso followed by pullback.congrHom gives e:Y isomorphic to X_Omega. Its two projection identities and pullback.hom_ext prove that the Omega/L action on Y intertwines with the restricted Omega/k action on X_Omega. An isomorphism is a homeomorphism; preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents applied to its inverse maps each component of Y to a component of X_Omega. Set.image_injective makes this map injective, so the finite image proves finiteness of components of Y, as in finite_components_homeomorph.

The spectrum of a field is nonempty and has exactly one point, hence Spec(Omega/L) is surjective. Stability of surjectivity under base change gives surjectivity of p:Y to X_L. For a component C of Y, its image under e is fixed by every Omega/L automorphism, since the restriction fixes L pointwise. The intertwining identity and injectivity of e on subsets give invariance of C. Omega/L is Galois by IsGalois.tower_top_intermediateField. Apply exists_closed_subset_of_galois_invariant over L to the closed set C to obtain the required closed subset A with p inverse-image A=C.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_intermediateField_closed_component_descent {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hfinite : (irreducibleComponents
      ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (SeparableClosure k)))))).Finite) :
    ∃ L : IntermediateField k (SeparableClosure k),
      Module.Finite k L ∧
      let Z := pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
      let Y := pullback
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom L.subtype))
      let p : Y ⟶ Z := pullback.fst
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom L.subtype))
      Function.Surjective p ∧ (irreducibleComponents ↥Y).Finite ∧
        ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents ↥Y,
          ∃ A : Set Z, IsClosed A ∧ p ⁻¹' A = C
